notes.title: Hamsterdam Release Date Reveal at E3 Kinda Funny Showcase
notes.notes:
Hi Hamster Squad!
We're incredibly proud and honoured that we are revealing our Release Trailer & Release Date:

Hamsterdam - Paws of Justice
AUGUST 1st
coming to Steam, Nintendo Switch, Google Play, and App Store.
https://youtu.be/gyT7gpDh4K4 We want to thank you all for your patience, and your trust in us. Through your support we were able to elevate a concept into a full blown game. Thank you all so much, from the bottom of our hearts.
- Team Muse


PS. 
We're currently live at Kinda Funny Games Showcase at E3! Please catch the stream revealing our announcement here: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ayw3J7sxEkQ
